note: Entry numbers follow docs/data-resources/data-resources.md (1-81). Fields are the organizers': Type, Modality, Description, Link, Data License, Paper, Species, Data Availability, More info. The 'Hack Playbook' link row in the database is excluded. Entry 60 (C2S-Scale) has no link in either source; matched by name.

datasets.More info: Upon request: https://www.nia.nih.gov/research/labs/blsa/about
datasets.Description: The BLSA is America's longest-running scientific study of human aging, launched in 1958 by the NIA.
datasets.Name: The Baltimore longitudinal study

datasets.More info: Upon request
datasets.Description: The GNPC is the world's largest protein biomarker discovery effort for neurodegenerative diseases. The consortium has harmonized over 250 million unique protein measurements from 35,000+ biofluid samples (plasma, serum, CSF) across 23 international research groups.
datasets.Name: The Global Neurodegeneration Proteomics Consortium

datasets.Description: 200,000 atomic-level structures determined by X-ray crystallography, NMR spectroscopy, and cryo-EM
datasets.Name: Protein Data Bank

datasets.Description: A Diffusion-based model to predict joint 3D structures of proteins, DNA, RNA, ligands, antibodies, and small molecules
datasets.Name: AlphaFold 3

datasets.Description: Tens of thousands of studies with millions of gene expression profiles covering disease perturbations, genetic perturbations (knockdown/knockout/overexpression), drug treatments, and various experimental conditions
datasets.Name: GEO

datasets.Description: A comprehensive resource for protein sequence and functional annotation
datasets.Name: Uniprot

datasets.Description: KEGG is a comprehensive knowledge base for systematic analysis of gene functions, integrating genomic, chemical, and systemic functional information.
datasets.Name: KEGG

datasets.Description: A comprehensive platform for systematic therapeutic target identification and validation. It integrates diverse public data sources including GWAS, rare disease genetics, somatic mutations in cancer, transcriptomics, approved drugs and clinical candidates, animal models, biochemical pathways, and text mining from medical literature
datasets.Name: OpenTarget

datasets.Description: The largest curated collection of standardized single-cell transcriptomic data, hosting 93+ million unique cells (169.3 million total) from 1,550+ datasets across 449 tissues and 40 assay types.
datasets.Name: CZ CELLxGENE Consensus

datasets.Description: A multidimensional cancer genomics data, providing access to somatic mutations, DNA copy-number alterations, mRNA and microRNA expression, DNA methylation, protein and phosphoprotein abundance (RPPA/mass spec), and clinical attributes
datasets.Name: Cbioportal

datasets.Description: A collection of annotated high-throughput microscopy image sets designed for testing, validating, and benchmarking automated image, covering diverse biological applications including cell segmentation, cell counting, phenotype classification, and dose-response experiments
datasets.Name: Broad Bioimage Benchmark Collection (BBBC)

datasets.Description: TCIA is the U.S. National Cancer Institute's public repository for cancer imaging and related information, containing 30.9 million HIPAA-compliant de-identified radiology images from approximately 37,568 subjects.
datasets.Name: The Cancer Imaging Archive

datasets.Description: A comprehensive parts list of all functional elements in the human and mouse genomes. The project employs diverse high-throughput assays including ChIP-seq, DNase-seq, RNA-seq, CAGE, FAIRE-seq, histone modifications mapping, DNA methylation profiling, and transcription factor binding identification.
datasets.Name: Encode

datasets.Description: A harmonized data from TCGA, TARGET, and other NCI programs, providing uniformly processed genomic, epigenomic, transcriptomic, proteomic, and clinical data
datasets.Name: Genomic Data Commons (GDC)

datasets.More info: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 International License
datasets.Description: RxRx is a series of open-source high-content microscopy datasets released by Recursion Pharmaceuticals. The collection includes: RxRx1 (125,510 images of 1,138 siRNA genetic perturbations across 4 cell types and 51 batches for batch correction studies); RxRx2 (131,953 images of HUVEC cells treated with 434 immune stimulants including cytokines, chemokines, growth factors for immune phenotyping); RxRx3 (the first genome-scale CRISPR knockout screen combined with multi-concentration compound screening); RxRx3-core (compressed 18GB subset with 222,601 images, 736 CRISPR knockouts, 1,674 compounds for drug-target interaction benchmarking); and RxRx19 (305,520 images screening 1,672 compounds against SARS-CoV-2 infection). All datasets feature 6-channel fluorescence microscopy images (1024x1024) with pre-computed deep learning embeddings (128-1024 dimensions). The datasets enable morphological profiling, phenotypic drug discovery, and representation learning research.
datasets.Name: RxRx Datasets

datasets.Description: LINCS is an NIH Common Fund program (2011-2020) that created a comprehensive library cataloging cellular responses to diverse perturbagens including small molecules, genetic perturbations (siRNA, CRISPR), antibodies, and microenvironmental factors. The database contains millions of gene expression signatures (L1000 assay measuring ~1,000 landmark genes), along with proteomics, imaging, and other cellular readouts across hundreds of cell lines and tissue types. Data includes transcriptional, epigenomic, proteomic, and phenotypic responses enabling mechanism of action (MoA) prediction, drug synergy analysis, and disease signature matching. Key resources include the LINCS Data Portal, iLINCS computational platform, and specialized centers including HMS LINCS (imaging), NeuroLINCS (neurodegenerative diseases), and MEP LINCS (microenvironment perturbations). The program developed computational tools for signature integration and now interfaces with the Common Fund Data Ecosystem (CFDE).
datasets.Name: LINC

datasets.Description: Tahoe-100M is the world's largest single-cell perturbation atlas containing 100 million transcriptomic profiles from 50 cancer cell lines exposed to 1,100+ small-molecule drug perturbations across 60,000 experimental conditions. The dataset supports drug discovery, mechanism of action prediction, resistance modeling, and systems biology research. Pre-computed embeddings and scVI models are available for efficient analysis.
datasets.Name: Tahoe-100M

datasets.Description: A genome-scale Perturb-seq dataset combining CRISPR interference (CRISPRi) with single-cell RNA sequencing across >2.5 million human cells.
datasets.Name: Genome-scale Perturb-seq (Replogle et al. 2022)

datasets.repo_name: TRADE Perturb-seq essential gene screens, GSE264667
datasets.Description: Large-scale dual sgRNA CRISPRi Perturb-seq screens conducted in parallel in Jurkat (T-cell leukemia) and HepG2 (hepatocellular carcinoma) cell lines.
datasets.Name: TRADE Perturb-seq Essential Gene Screens (GSE264667)

datasets.More info: CC BY 4.0
datasets.Description: Perturb-seq experiments in six different cancer cell lines from different tissues of origin: A549 (lung), MCF7 (breast), HT29 (colon), HAP1 (bone marrow), BxPC3 (pancreas), and K562 (bone marrow).
datasets.Name: Mixscale Pathway Reconstruction Perturb-seq (Jiang et al. 2025)

datasets.Description: sci-Plex is a massively multiplex single-cell transcriptomics platform combining nuclear hashing with sci-RNA-seq (single-cell combinatorial indexing) to profile global transcriptional responses to chemical perturbations. The proof-of-concept dataset contains ~650,000 single-cell transcriptomes across ~5,000 independent samples from one experiment, screening 188 small molecule compounds (including HDAC inhibitors, kinase inhibitors, transcription modulators) across three cancer cell lines (A549, MCF7, K562) plus HEK293T and NIH3T3 cells.
datasets.Name: sci-Plex Chemical Transcriptomics (GSE139944)

datasets.Description: sci-Plex-GxE (Gene-by-Environment) is a platform combining CRISPR-based genetic perturbations with chemical screening at single-cell resolution. This dataset profiles 14,121 gene-by-environment combinations across 1,052,205 single-cell transcriptomes in glioblastoma. The study systematically screens all 522 human protein kinases using CRISPRi/CRISPRa (dCas9-KRAB/SunTag) in seven glioblastoma cell lines (A172, T98G, U87MG, GBM4, GBM8, GSC0131, GSC0827) exposed to 27 kinase inhibitors targeting RTK pathway signaling. Identifies MEK/MAPK-dependent compensatory adaptive signaling signatures and reveals promising combination therapies including dual MEK + CDC7/CDK9 or NF-κB inhibitors to prevent transcriptional adaptation to targeted therapy. Uses nuclear hashing via sci-RNA-seq with gRNA capture enrichment. Demonstrates how individual kinases contribute to drug resistance mechanisms in cancer.
datasets.Name: sci-Plex-GxE Glioblastoma Kinome Screen (GSE225775)

datasets.More info: CC BY-NC 4.0 for non-commercial use; commercial licensing available from Parse Biosciences
datasets.Description: The largest single-cell cytokine response atlas containing 9,697,974 single-cell transcriptomes from 12 healthy human donors (6 male, 6 female) treated with 90 different cytokines plus PBS controls for 24 hours, totaling 1,092 experimental conditions.
datasets.Name: Parse 10 Million PBMC Cytokine Atlas

datasets.More info: Downloadable data under CC BY-SA 4.0 with attribution; antibody images carry separate usage terms. Versioned annual releases; searchable portal and API at proteinatlas.org.
datasets.Description: Maps protein expression and localisation across human tissues, organs, single cells, subcellular structures and disease (the Pathology Atlas covers the major cancers) using antibody-based immunohistochemistry, transcriptomics and mass spectrometry. The linked page is the bulk download hub, with per-sub-atlas tables (TSV), XML and RDF exports.
datasets.Name: Human Protein Atlas

datasets.Description: An overview of age-related diseases incl. data on incidence, etiology, clinical trials, animal models, and more
datasets.Name: Norn Group Age-Related Diseases Overview

datasets.Description: Aging Atlas is a comprehensive multi-omics database for aging biology. The database comprises five main modules: transcriptomics (RNA-seq), single-cell transcriptomics (scRNA-seq), epigenomics (ChIP-seq), proteomics (protein-protein interactions), and pharmacogenomics (geroprotective compounds).
datasets.Name: Aging Atlas

datasets.More info: Only GUI. Could email nmorais@fm.ul.pt for data access
datasets.Description: voyAGEr is a free web application providing flexible visualization and functional analysis of age-related gene expression alterations across 49 human tissues. Built on GTEx project RNA-seq data from 900+ donors aged 20-70 years
datasets.Name: VoyAGEr

datasets.More info: Only GUI. Could  email: antonio.delsol@uni.lu for access data
datasets.Description: SINGULAR is a cell rejuvenation atlas providing unified systems biology analysis of diverse rejuvenation strategies across multiple organs at single-cell resolution. The database characterizes effects of 6 rejuvenation strategies.
datasets.Name: Single-cell RNA-seq Investigation of Rejuvenation Agens and Longevity (SINGULAR)

datasets.repo_name: Healthy ageing blood single-cell atlas, Terekhova et al. 2023
datasets.Description: Comprehensive large-scale single-cell profiling of healthy human blood across aging. The dataset contains ~2 million cells from 317 samples collected from 166 healthy individuals aged 25-85 years over a 3-year period. Uses single-cell RNA-seq/TCR-seq/BCR-seq with protein feature barcoding (CITE-seq with 20 antibodies). Identifies 50-55 immune cell subpopulations, with 14 changing significantly with age.
datasets.Name: Single-cell atlas of human blood during healthy aging (Terekhova et al. 2023)

datasets.Description: A manually-curated, publicly accessible database housing published, statistically-significant relationships between biomarkers and all-cause mortality in population-based or generally healthy human samples. Contains 1,576-1,587 biomarker associations involving 471 distinct biomarkers curated from over 30 years of research across hundreds of publications. Biomarkers span diverse types including hematologic (e.g., red blood cell distribution width), molecular (e.g., DNA methylation changes), protein-based, metabolic, and physical parameters (e.g., grip strength).
datasets.Name: Monthly predictor markers

datasets.Description: LongevityMap is a manually-curated database of human genetic variants associated with longevity. It contains 3,144 genetic variants across 884 genes previously studied in the context of human longevity.
datasets.Name: Longevity Map

datasets.Description: The Geroprotectors.org database comprises more than 250 life-extension experiments in 11 wild-type model organisms (including M. musculus and C. elegans, among others)
datasets.Name: Geroprotectors.org

datasets.More info: Two tiers. Open: expression medians, QTL summary statistics and browser tracks download directly from the portal. Protected: individual-level genotypes and raw expression require dbGaP authorised access (phs000424) via gtexportal.org/home/protectedDataAccess.
datasets.Description: NIH Genotype-Tissue Expression project: RNA-seq gene expression, splicing and QTL maps (eQTLs and sQTLs) across 50+ non-diseased human tissues from ~1,000 post-mortem donors, linked to whole-genome sequencing. The reference resource for regulatory genetic variation in human tissues.
datasets.Name: The Adult Genotype-Tissue Expression (GTEx)

datasets.More info: CC licenses vary by dataset
datasets.Description: A comprehensive reference map of all human cell types. It contains 62.7 million cells from 9,200 donors across 478 projects spanning 18 Biological Networks (brain, lung, heart, liver, kidney, gut, immune, reproductive, developmental, eye, skin, blood, musculoskeletal, oral/craniofacial, organoid, and others). Employs single-cell RNA-seq, single-nucleus RNA-seq, spatial transcriptomics, ATAC-seq, proteomics, and imaging to map cellular diversity across tissues, developmental stages, and disease states. Includes landmark atlases: Human Brain Cell Atlas v1.0 (3M+ nuclei, 461 cell clusters, 3 donors); Human Retina Atlas (3.4M cells, 120+ cell types, 122 donors); Tabula Sapiens (500K cells, 24 organs); and tissue-specific atlases for airways, heart, kidney, liver, and more. Data integrated via CELLxGENE, UCSC Cell Browser, and HCA Data Portal. Over 3,200 members from 1,700+ institutes in 99 countries.
datasets.Name: Human Cell Atlas

datasets.More info: CC BY 4.0
datasets.Description: Tabula Sapiens v2 is an expanded benchmark human cell atlas containing 1.1+ million cells from 28 organs across 24 normal human subjects (11 male, 13 female, ages 22-74).
datasets.Name: Tabula Sapiens v2

datasets.repo_name: Organ aging plasma proteome, Oh et al. 2023
datasets.Description: Plasma proteomics study measuring 4,978 proteins via SomaLogic SomaScan assay across 5,676 subjects from five independent cohorts. Creates 11 organ-specific aging models (brain, heart, kidney, liver, lung, pancreas, intestine, muscle, fat, vasculature, immune system) by mapping organ-enriched plasma proteins using GTEx RNA-seq data (893 organ-enriched proteins, 18%). Machine learning models (LASSO regression with bootstrap aggregation) predict organ-specific "age gaps"—differences between biological and chronological age—that track health and disease at the organ level.
datasets.Name: Organ Aging Signatures in Plasma Proteome (Oh et al. 2023)

datasets.Description: A curated database of human genes associated with cellular senescence
datasets.Name: CellAge

datasets.More info: Raw Data Available
datasets.Description: A number of useful DNA methylation data sets from GEO related to aging or age-related diseases. Biolearn is an open-source Python library providing harmonized access to 40+ DNA methylation datasets from GEO totaling ~15,000+ samples for biomarkers of aging research. Implements 20+ pre-trained epigenetic aging clocks including Horvath (2013), Hannum, PhenoAge, GrimAge, DunedinPACE, AltumAge, PCGrimAge, DNAmTL (telomere length), and pan-mammalian clocks.
datasets.Name: DNA methylation Datasets (GEO/Biolearn)

datasets.More info: freely accessible under HAGR license
datasets.Description: AnAge is the world's most comprehensive manually-curated database of ageing and life history in animals, part of Human Ageing Genomic Resources (HAGR). Contains 4,671 entries spanning 9 animal phyla.
datasets.Name: AnAge (Animal Ageing and Longevity Database)

datasets.More info: freely accessible under HAGR license
datasets.Description: DrugAge is a manually-curated database of drugs, compounds, and supplements with lifespan-extending properties in model organisms, part of Human Ageing Genomic Resources (HAGR). Contains 1,316 entries covering 418 distinct compounds curated from 324+ publications across 27 model organisms including C. elegans (majority), D. melanogaster, yeast, mice, and rats.
datasets.Name: DrugAge

datasets.More info: Data browser access; specific dataset access policies vary
datasets.Description: The Mammalian Methylation Consortium data browser provides access to the world's largest cross-species epigenetic aging database, containing 15,000+ DNA methylation samples from 348 mammalian species profiled using the Horvath Mammalian Array (37,492 highly conserved CpGs).
datasets.Name: Mammalian Methylation Consortium Data Browser

datasets.Description: Comprehensive multimodal single-cell and single-nucleus transcriptomic atlas of skeletal muscle aging across the adult human lifespan. Contains 90,902 single cells and 92,259 single nuclei from intercostal muscle of 17 donors (8 young ~20-40 years, 9 aged ~60-75 years) profiling 40 major skeletal muscle populations including muscle stem cells (MuSCs), myofibers, fibroblasts, smooth muscle cells, pericytes, endothelial cells, adipocytes, Schwann cells, and immune cells.
datasets.Name: Muscle Ageing Cell Atlas

datasets.Description: Pathoage is a comprehensive resource exploring thousands of tissue-specific clinical features associated with age and mortality extracted from over 33 million text descriptions of histological samples from The Danish National Pathology Register.
datasets.Name: PathoAge

datasets.Description: SenOmic is a comprehensive transcriptomic database for senescent human fibroblasts developed by the Shanley lab at Newcastle University. Contains systematically curated data from 119 studies representing 1,069 sample comparisons across 14 types of senescence.
datasets.Name: SenOmic (Cellular Senescence Transcriptomic Database)

datasets.Description: AgingReG is a manually curated database focusing on regulatory relationships during aging with experimental evidence. Contains 2,157 aging factor entries including 1,345 aging gene entries, 804 external factor entries (compounds, environmental factors, lifestyle factors), and 8 aging-related pathway entries curated from 1,784 published studies.
datasets.Name: AgingReG (Aging Regulatory Relationships Database)

datasets.More info: Raw data available
datasets.Description: ClockBase is a comprehensive platform for biological age profiling featuring multiple aging clock models applied to >2,000 DNA methylation datasets totaling ~200,000 samples. Implements 11 aging clocks: 7 human epigenetic clocks
datasets.Name: ClockBase

datasets.More info: IHME datasets: IHME FREE-OF-CHARGE NON-COMMERCIAL USER AGREEMENT; external datasets: varies by provider; some open access, some require registration/request
datasets.Description: GHDx is the world's most comprehensive catalog of health and demographic data. It contains metadata and links to thousands of datasets including surveys, censuses, vital statistics, administrative records, disease registries, environmental monitoring, epidemiological surveillance, scientific literature, and modeled data from global sources.
datasets.Name: Global Health Data Exchange (GHDx)

datasets.More info: Open Access: freely available with attribution; Restricted/Credentialed Access: requires registration/training and signed Data Use Agreement
datasets.Description: PhysioNet is one of the world's largest and most comprehensive open-access repositories of physiological signals and related data. It contains 400+ databases spanning cardiovascular (ECG, blood pressure, heart rate variability), neurological (EEG, sleep studies), respiratory, gait, and other biosignals from healthy subjects and patients with conditions including arrhythmias, heart failure, epilepsy, sleep apnea, Parkinson's disease, and aging.
datasets.Name: MIMIC IV

datasets.More info: Health Data License; requires login via verified ID, agreement to use only for T2DM research, specific terms around data usage/security/secondary sharing
datasets.Description: A multimodal dataset designed for  type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) with focus on salutogenesis (pathways from disease to health). Version 2.0 contains data from 1,067 participants. Triple-balanced by race/ethnicity (Asian, Black, Hispanic, White), biological sex (male, female), and diabetes severity across 15+ modalities: 12-lead ECG and Holter monitoring (WFDB format), retinal imaging (fundus photography, OCT, OCTA, FLIO in DICOM), continuous glucose monitoring (Open mHealth), wearable activity monitoring, clinical data (OMOP CDM), environmental sensors, cognitive assessments, blood/urine biomarkers, and social determinants of health.
datasets.Name: AI-READI (Artificial Intelligence Ready and Equitable Atlas for Diabetes Insights)

datasets.More info: CC0 1.0 / CC BY 4.0
datasets.Description: PrimeKG is a multimodal precision medicine knowledge graph integrating 20 high-quality biomedical resources including DisGeNET, DrugBank, UMLS, Orphanet, Gene Ontology, Reactome, HPO, MONDO, OMIM, and others. Contains 129,375 nodes across 10 biological scales (diseases, drugs, proteins/genes, pathways, biological processes, anatomical structures, phenotypes, molecular functions, cellular components, exposures) connected by 4,050,249 relationships spanning 30 edge types. Describes 17,080 diseases (including 90.8% of Orphanet's 9,348 rare diseases) with rich drug-disease relationships including indications, contraindications, and off-label uses typically missing from other knowledge graphs.
datasets.Name: PrimeKG (Precision Medicine Knowledge Graph)

datasets.More info: Code: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; Model weights/outputs: Arc Research Institute State Model Non-Commercial License with Acceptable Use Policy; noncommercial use only
datasets.Description: A virtual cell model for predicting cellular responses to genetic, chemical, and signaling perturbations across diverse contexts.
datasets.Name: State

datasets.More info: specific license TBD; model checkpoints to be released
datasets.Description: A multimodal biological reasoning model that deeply integrates a DNA foundation model (Evo 2) with a large language model (Qwen3) for interpretable genomic reasoning.
datasets.Name: BioReason

datasets.More info: MIT License; individual data sources may have own licenses
datasets.Description: Holy Bio MCP is a unified framework aggregating 5+ specialized Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers. Provides 51+ specialized bioinformatics functions through single unified configuration, integrating: gget-mcp (genomics toolkit wrapping gget library), opengenes-mcp (OpenGenes aging/longevity database), synergy-age-mcp (SynergyAge synergistic genetic interactions), biothings-mcp (BioThings.io APIs for genes/variants/compounds), pharmacology-mcp (Guide to PHARMACOLOGY drug database), plus futurehouse-mcp, addgene-mcp, boltz-mcp, benchling-mcp. Native ElizaOS plugin (biostratum-eliza) enables autonomous AI agents for complex agentic workflows.
datasets.Name: Holy Bio MCP

datasets.repo_name: Human ovary cellular atlas, Jones et al. 2024
datasets.Description: spatial and single-cell transcriptomic atlas of the healthy reproductive-age human ovary at cellular resolution. Combines morphologically-guided spatial transcriptomics (GeoMx platform) profiling >18,000 genes across 257 custom-selected regions from 2 premenopausal donors with single-cell RNA-seq from 21,198 cells across 3 additional donors.
datasets.Name: Cellular Atlas of the Human Ovary (Jones et al. 2024)

datasets.More info: CC BY 3.0; requires NBIA Data Retriever for download
datasets.Description: CBIS-DDSM is a curated, standardized version of the Digital Database for Screening Mammography (DDSM) designed for development and evaluation of computer-aided detection (CADe) and diagnosis (CADx) systems. Contains 10,239 mammography images (163.6 GB) from 1,566 patients across 2,620 scanned film studies including normal, benign, and malignant cases with verified pathology. Features 753 calcification cases and 891 mass cases.
datasets.Name: CBIS-DDSM (Curated Breast Imaging Subset of DDSM)

datasets.More info: Small dataset
datasets.Description: A small synthetic/simulated menstrual cycle tracking dataset for educational purposes and app development. Contains 1 CSV file (38 KB) with cycle tracking data for predicting menstrual days and ovulation.
datasets.Name: Kaggle Menstrual Cycle Data (Bisht 2021)

datasets.repo_name: Natural Cycles menstrual cycle dataset, Bull et al. 2019
datasets.More info: aggregated data in publication; individual-level data requires data sharing agreement per study
datasets.Description: A menstrual cycle datasets ever compiled, containing 600,000+ menstrual cycles from 124,648 users aged 18-45 of the Natural Cycles fertility tracking app (collected Sept 2016-Feb 2019). Includes prospectively collected data: daily basal body temperature (BBT), cycle-by-cycle menstruation dates, urinary LH test results, age, BMI, mode (pregnancy prevention vs. planning). Automated algorithm retrospectively detects BBT rise following ovulation. Analysis reveals: mean cycle length 29.3 days (SD 4.0); only 13% of women have 28-day cycles; 65% experience variability ≥7 days in shortest vs. longest cycles; ovulation day varies substantially (median day 17, range 13-21).
datasets.Name: Natural Cycles Menstrual Cycle Dataset (Bull et al. 2019)

datasets.repo_name: Ovarian aging single-cell atlas, Isola et al. 2024
datasets.Description: Comprehensive single-cell RNA-seq atlas of the aging mouse ovary comparing young (3-month) vs. reproductively aged (9-month) mice to identify early drivers of ovarian decline before follicular exhaustion. Contains scRNA-seq from 8 ovaries (4 per age group) capturing 41,742 cells across 13 distinct cell types including granulosa cells, theca cells, oocytes, stromal fibroblasts, endothelial cells, smooth muscle, and 6 immune cell subtypes.
datasets.Name: Ovarian Aging Single-Cell Atlas (Isola et al. 2024)

datasets.More info: web interface freely accessible; specific data/model licensing TBD
datasets.Description: TxGNN is a graph foundation model for zero-shot drug repurposing, identifying therapeutic candidates for diseases with limited or no treatment options. Trained on a medical knowledge graph covering 17,080 diseases (92% lacking FDA-approved drugs) and 7,957 drug candidates, spanning 9,388 indications and 30,675 contraindications. Integrates 27,671 proteins, 28,642 biological processes, 15,311 molecular functions, 11,169 phenotypes, 4,176 cellular components, 2,516 pathways, 14,035 anatomies, and 818 environmental exposures. Uses graph neural network with metric learning to predict therapeutic candidates for diseases never encountered during training.
datasets.Name: TxGNN (Therapeutic Graph Neural Network)

datasets.More info: specific C2S-Scale release terms TBD
datasets.Description: C2S-Scale is a large-scale foundation model built on Google's Gemma family designed to interpret single-cell transcriptomic data by converting cellular molecular signatures into "cell sentences." Trained on massive single-cell datasets to understand cellular states, communication, and context.
datasets.Name: Cell2Sentence-Scale (C2S-Scale)

datasets.More info: specific licensing varies by dataset component; generally permissive for research use)
datasets.Description: A comprehensive resource for cancer cell line characterization, drug sensitivity profiling, and genetic dependency mapping
datasets.Name: CCLE/DepMap (Cancer Cell Line Encyclopedia / Cancer Dependency Map)

datasets.More info: datasets have individual licenses
datasets.Description: OpenML is a collaborative open science platform for sharing machine learning datasets, algorithms, and experiments across all domains. Contains 24,000+ datasets spanning computer vision, time series, classification, regression, and clustering tasks. While not exclusively biomedical, includes significant medical/biological content: medical imaging datasets, microarray gene expression data, clinical diagnostic datasets, disease prediction datasets, and genomics benchmarks.
datasets.Name: OpenML

datasets.More info: specific license TBD
datasets.Description: M³-20M is the largest open-access multi-modal molecule dataset for AI-driven drug design and discovery, containing over 20 million molecules
datasets.Name: M³-20M (Multi-Modal Molecule Dataset)

datasets.Description: NASA OSDR consolidates the Ames Life Sciences Data Archive (ALSDA) and GeneLab into a unified open-access platform for spaceflight and space-relevant biological research. Contains 500+ studies with multi-modal data: GeneLab provides omics data (transcriptomics, metagenomics, epigenomics, proteomics, metabolomics, bisulfite-seq) while ALSDA contributes physiological, phenotypic, behavioral, bioimaging, and environmental data. Includes 200+ omics datasets, 75+ studies from GeneLab's Sample Processing Lab (SPL), and 300+ payload/mission/hardware records.
datasets.Name: NASA OSDR (Open Science Data Repository)

datasets.repo_name: HALD, Human Aging and Longevity Dataset
datasets.More info: CC BY 4.0
datasets.Description: HALD is a comprehensive text mining-based knowledge graph for precision gerontology and geroscience, automatically extracted from all human aging and longevity-related literature in PubMed (339,918 abstracts as of September 2023).
datasets.Name: HALD (Human Aging and Longevity Dataset)

datasets.repo_name: HALL, Human Aging and Longevity Landscape
datasets.Description: A comprehensive multi-omics cohort-based database dedicated to human aging and longevity research. Aggregates data from 171 diverse cohorts across 66 countries/regions encompassing >4.8 million individuals aged 1-119 years, including 59 cohorts with centenarians.
datasets.Name: HALL (Human Aging and Longevity Landscape)

datasets.Description: 14,705 U.S. participants (nationally representative, ages 3+) wore ActiGraph GT3X+ wrist accelerometers continuously for 7 days. Includes: step counts from 5 validated algorithms (ADEPT, Oak, stepcount SSL/RF, Verisense original/revised, ActiLife), ActiGraph Activity Counts, Monitor-Independent Movement Summary (MIMS) units, wake/sleep/non-wear predictions, data quality flags, demographics, health outcomes, laboratory biomarkers, and mortality linkage. Distribution: 7,681 females (3,054 youth, 4,525 adults 20+), 7,126 males (2,976 youth, 4,150 adults). Mean 4.2-6.3 valid days per person.
datasets.Name: NHANES 2011-2014 Accelerometer Dataset (PhysioNet)

datasets.repo_name: SWAN, Study of Women's Health Across the Nation
datasets.More info: free ICPSR registration only, no institutional affiliation required
datasets.Description: A longitudinal study of healthy women transitioning through menopause. Enrolled 3,302 healthy women aged 42-52 years (premenopausal/early perimenopausal at baseline) across 7 U.S. sites in 1996-1997, with 30+ years of continuous follow-up (baseline through Follow-Up Visit 17+)
datasets.Name: SWAN (Study of Women's Health Across the Nation)

datasets.repo_name: ELSA, English Longitudinal Study of Ageing
datasets.More info: free UK Data Service registration required, ~2 minutes
datasets.Description: Large-scale longitudinal study of 12,099 men and women aged 50+ in England, followed biennially since 2002. Includes: physical health (cardiovascular measures, lung function, inflammatory markers, anthropometry, grip strength, walking speed, chair stands), cognitive function (memory, executive function, processing speed), mental health (depression, anxiety, quality of life, loneliness), biomarkers (blood samples for lipids, HbA1c, CRP, fibrinogen, vitamin D, IGF-1, cortisol, DNA/genetics), medication use, health behaviors (smoking, alcohol, physical activity, diet via Oxford WebQ), socioeconomic status (wealth, income, employment, pension), social networks, and dementia sub-study with harmonized protocols.
datasets.Name: ELSA (English Longitudinal Study of Ageing)

datasets.Description: US Longitudinal study of aging with 37,000+ individuals aged 50+ in 23,000 households. Comprehensive data: income/wealth, work/retirement, health conditions, cognitive function (memory, executive function), depression (CES-D), functional limitations, healthcare utilization, insurance coverage, biomarkers (blood pressure, BMI, HbA1c, cholesterol, CRP, cystatin C), physical performance (grip strength, walking speed, peak flow), DNA/genetics, and linked administrative records (Social Security earnings, Medicare claims, National Death Index)
datasets.Name: HRS (Health and Retirement Study)

datasets.repo_name: MHAS, Mexican Health and Aging Study
datasets.More info: Registration required
datasets.Description: longitudinal study of 15,186 adults aged 50+ in Mexico (plus spouses of any age), followed since 2001. Comprehensive data via computer-assisted interviews: chronic conditions, functional limitations (ADLs, IADLs), cognitive function (verbal learning, memory, verbal fluency, visuospatial ability), depression (CES-D-9), anthropometry (height, weight, waist), blood pressure, medications, healthcare access/utilization, health insurance, employment/retirement, income/assets/wealth, pensions, family structure, intergenerational transfers, migration history. Blood sample collection in subsample for biomarkers (glucose, HbA1c, cholesterol, CRP, creatinine). Women comprise 56% (8,500+)
datasets.Name: MHAS (Mexican Health and Aging Study)

datasets.repo_name: LASI, Longitudinal Aging Study in India
datasets.More info: Registeration required
datasets.Description: 72,250 individuals aged 45+ plus spouses. Comprehensive data via computer-assisted interviews: chronic diseases (cardiovascular, diabetes, cancer, respiratory, arthritis), functional health (ADLs, IADLs, mobility, pain), cognition (memory, orientation, executive function, numeracy), mental health (depression, anxiety, life satisfaction), biomarkers (anthropometry, blood pressure, lung function spirometry, vision tests, grip strength, walking speed, balance), blood samples (glucose, HbA1c, lipids, CRP, hemoglobin, kidney/liver function), healthcare access/utilization/costs, health insurance, work/retirement, income/wealth/assets/consumption, pensions, family structure, intergenerational transfers, social networks, discrimination, time use. Special sub-study LASI-DAD (Diagnostic Assessment of Dementia): 4,096 participants with comprehensive dementia evaluation. Women comprise 50% (36,000+)
datasets.Name: LASI (Longitudinal Aging Study in India)

datasets.repo_name: UK Biobank age at menopause GWAS
datasets.Description: UK Biobank GWAS summary statistics for age at menopause (last menstrual period) from 65,307 postmenopausal women. Includes genome-wide association data enabling identification of genetic variants associated with menopause timing. Women self-reported age at last menstrual period (range: 30-60 years, mean ~50 years). Genetic associations provide insights into biological pathways regulating ovarian aging including DNA damage repair, hormonal signaling, and ovarian reserve depletion. Can be combined with polygenic risk scores for personalized menopause timing prediction.
datasets.Name: UK Biobank Age at Menopause GWAS

datasets.Description: WHO's flagship multi-country longitudinal aging study with 42,464 adults aged 18+ (34,124 aged 50+) from 6 countries
datasets.Name: SAGE (WHO Study on Global AGEing and Adult Health)

datasets.More info: Free registration (1-2 days)
datasets.Description: database of semi-supercentenarians (105-109) and supercentenarians (110+). Contains 22,135 validated extreme longevity cases from 13 countries. Includes individual-level data: exact birth date, death date (or living status), sex, age at death/current age, validation source (birth certificate, census records, baptismal records), and geographic location.
datasets.Name: IDL (International Database on Longevity)

datasets.More info: CC BY 4.0
datasets.Description: Aggregated whole-genome sequencing data from 81 Italian semi-supercentenarians (105-110 years old, mean age 106.6) and 36 younger controls (mean age 68 years) from 90X high-coverage sequencing. Contains aggregated variant data including: germline SNVs/indels analysis, somatic mutation patterns, loss-of-function (LoF) variant burden, DNA damage repair gene analysis, and clonal hematopoiesis markers.
datasets.Name: Italian Semi-Supercentenarian WGS Aggregated Data

datasets.More info: Curated compound sets (MLP Probes, Nature Chemical Biology probes, SGC sets, Open Science Probes) with live/fixed versioning; searchable by compound, target or set. Maintained by the Institute of Molecular Genetics of the Czech Academy of Sciences.
datasets.Description: Interactive open portal integrating chemical probes and approved drugs: compound structures, target annotations, bioactivity data and probe-quality scoring, aggregating sources including ChEMBL, Guide to PHARMACOLOGY, the Chemical Probes Portal and SGC. Quality flags help steer users away from historical or obsolete compounds toward the best-available probe for a target.
datasets.Name: Probes & Drugs Portal

datasets.More info: Free REST API and full database dumps (PostgreSQL); ligand structures with SMILES/InChI; every data point linked to primary literature. Licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Note: the supplied login.jsp URL is just the account portal; main access needs no login, so the canonical homepage is stored here.
datasets.Description: Expert-curated database of pharmacological targets (GPCRs, ion channels, catalytic receptors, nuclear hormone receptors, enzymes, transporters) and their ligands, with quantitative binding and functional activity data, NC-IUPHAR nomenclature, and curated coverage of approved drugs and clinical candidates. Includes the Guide to Immunopharmacology and Guide to Malaria Pharmacology portals.
datasets.Name: IUPHAR/BPS Guide to PHARMACOLOGY (GtoPdb)

datasets.More info: Compound structures as SMILES; bioactivity data also deposited in ChEMBL for long-term storage. Project ran 2020-2025; the Gateway remains the open dissemination route. Consortium overview in RSC Medicinal Chemistry (Toward Target 2035 paper).
datasets.Description: Data portal of the EUbOPEN IMI public-private consortium (22 academic and industry partners): an open chemogenomic library of ~5,000 annotated compounds covering ~1,000 proteins (about a third of the druggable genome), 100+ high-quality chemical probes, and associated bioactivity, structure, vendor and patient-derived assay data. Compound sets are organised by target family, including kinases, epigenetic regulators and membrane proteins.
datasets.Name: EUbOPEN Gateway

datasets.More info: Raw images served via the Cell Painting Gallery on AWS; processed profiles on S3; analysis tooling via pycytominer. Data released CC0. Companion site: jump-cellpainting.broadinstitute.org. Reference paper covers the matched chemical-genetic set of ~3 million images.
datasets.Description: Public morphological profiling resource from the JUMP-Cell Painting Consortium (Broad Institute with 10 pharma and 6 technology partners): Cell Painting images and extracted feature profiles for over 136,000 chemical and genetic perturbations (~116,750 compounds, ~12,600 ORF overexpression constructs, ~7,975 CRISPR-Cas9 knockouts) in U2OS human cells. JUMP-Hub is the central index for browsing, downloading and citing the data.
datasets.Name: JUMP Cell Painting (JUMP-CP)

datasets.More info: Portal supports browsing by tissue, cell type and age, plus bulk downloads with FACS and droplet datasets kept separate; AWS S3 mirror available. Processed objects also accessible via CZ CELLxGENE.
datasets.Description: Single-cell transcriptomic atlas of mouse ageing from the Tabula Muris Senis Consortium (CZ Biohub): ~350,000 cells from 23 tissues and organs across the lifespan (1 to 30 months), profiled with both FACS-based full-length (Smart-seq2) and droplet (10x Chromium) scRNA-seq. Enables analysis of age-related changes in cell-type composition and gene expression across the whole organism.
datasets.Name: Tabula Muris Senis
